study_note: One fresh auxiliary-return H3/J8/K3 Humanoid Walk full-training run. Matches the launched H3/J8 aux-return recipe with runtime aux_return_joint_vmap=false; the scientific change is inner_solve_interval=3. Solve at real episode decisions0,3,6,... using J8/C16/A4/N128/B256, and hold the adapted feedback actor plus solve-time encoder snapshot between solves. Every held decision still observes the new real state, samples a fresh action, appends real replay, and performs the ordinary outer update. Inner actor, critic, temperature, replay and optimizers start fresh at each solve; no Bernoulli transfer. The primary outer critic is entropy-augmented; inner critic initialization and horizon bootstrap use the auxiliary return critic with reward-only inner targets. Shared representation receives the auxiliary loss. Seed55,500k decisions (1M raw environment steps),2500 warmup decisions and2500 pretraining updates. Preserve every25k portable checkpoint and use durable exact-resume generations at episode boundaries. Evaluation remains disabled; W&B ambi reports actual training returns, solve/held counts, diagnostics and costs.
